name: bg-thunderstorm
title: Thunderstorm Background
blurb: Animated shader renders roiling storm clouds and lightning flashes.
description: ShaderToy shader with Perlin noise generating procedural storm effect. Multiple light sources create glowing energy discharges across turbulent background.
use_when: Dramatic hero section with energy or danger theme.
avoid_when: Users with photosensitivity or motion sensitivity concerns.
a11y: Highly dynamic animation; lacks prefers-reduced-motion support.
